facts.activity_file: testing earth leakage and protection settings

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - thermal exposure at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-3100 and TX-3001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during shift handover while the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 6 October 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on SG-3100 and TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
